method: Path A: WebSearch/WebFetch plus the free public GitHub and pypistats APIs. No paid provider, no database. Every figure below was read on a page fetched on checked_at; quote is the sentence (or <=125-char fragment) that states it.

how_to_load.metrics: tools.data.metrics.<key> = value (bare number). Nested keys: github.stars -> data.metrics.github.stars; pypi.downloads_last_month -> data.metrics.pypi.downloads_last_month.
how_to_load.provenance: tools.data.metrics_provenance.<key> = { source: source_url, as_of, scope } (the existing {source, as_of} shape plus scope).
how_to_load.info: tools.data.info.{description, features, company, business{pricing_model, base_price, free_tier, enterprise_pricing}}
how_to_load.only_include_in_0033_true: The loader (scripts/load-productivity-metrics.ts) writes metrics for every tool here and never changes status. Migration 0033 activates only the tools with include_in_0033 true; the others stay inactive, so their metrics are not shown.

scope_values.product: The figure is about this product.
scope_values.parent: The figure is about the parent company or the vendor's wider product family (owner ruling D80.1). The loader must carry scope into metrics_provenance.

source_type_values.vendor: Page published by the vendor, or a public API of the vendor's repository host.
source_type_values.third_party: Press or a research site reporting a figure; attributed_to names who the article credits.
source_type_values.third_party_estimate: The third party's own estimate, not a company statement.

engine_keys.file: lib/ranking-algorithm-v76.ts at origin/main (read with git show origin/main:...). Productivity uses the same engine.
info.technical.llm_providers: 1100 (resilience); not filled: no vendor page fetched lists providers
engine_keys.units: users is stored as a bare count whatever the period; the period is in unit. monthly_arr is annual recurring revenue in the stated currency (the key name is historical). Engine clamps: users 5K-1M, ARR 100K-400M, valuation 100M-5B, funding 10M+; every figure here is above the clamp or below it with no effect on the loader.

threshold.rule: include_in_0033 is true only when all three hold: (i) at least one usage or traction figure from {users, monthly_arr, github.stars} is verified; (ii) at least one more engine-scored figure from {users, monthly_arr, valuation, funding, github.stars, pypi.downloads_last_month} is verified (parent figures count, D80.1); (iii) at least one pricing fact for the product is verified on a fetched page.
threshold.why: One figure leaves the adoption or traction factor on a single, possibly stale, number. Valuation and funding alone describe the company, not the product.

not_obtained_for_any_tool: metrics.news_mentions: computed from the site's own news corpus, which needs database access (not allowed here).
info.technical.llm_providers and recent_updates_2025: no fetched vendor page states them.

Vendor-page fetches blocked (HTTP 403): openai.com, chatgpt.com price figures, businesswire.com, genspark.ai/pricing and home page, x.ai/grok, techleap. Figures that would have come from them use a fetched third-party page and are marked third_party.

chatgpt.include_reason: users (product) + annualised revenue, valuation, funding (parent, D80.1) verified; plan names and free tier verified on chatgpt.com/pricing.

users.quote: ChatGPT now supports more than 900 million weekly active users
users.note: Lower bound ('more than'). Weekly, not monthly. openai.com returned 403, so OpenAI's own post was not read.

monthly_arr.quote: the company had topped $25 billion in annualised revenue, up from $21.4 billion at the end of 2025
monthly_arr.note: OpenAI-wide revenue (API and enterprise included), not ChatGPT alone. The same-day thenextweb page quotes OpenAI at $2 billion revenue per month.

valuation.quote: valuing the ChatGPT maker at $852 billion post-money

funding.quote: OpenAI announced that it had closed its latest funding round with $122 billion in committed capital

features: Unlimited text chats on the Free plan, subject to abuse guardrails
Advanced reasoning models on Plus and above

business_source.quote: Free (Intelligence for everyday tasks) / Go / Plus / Pro plans listed
business_source.note: The fetched page shows plan names but no dollar amounts, so base_price is left null (third-party guides say Go $8, Plus $20, unconfirmed).

gemini-app.include_reason: Only one engine-scored figure is verified (users). Fails threshold (ii). It is one figure short; the figure is vendor-stated and strong, so the owner can waive the threshold for this row. No Alphabet figure for ARR, valuation or funding exists that is specific enough to use.

users.quote: the Gemini app, which now has 950 million monthly active users, with daily active users tripling in the last year.
users.note: Later press reports 1 billion (August 2026, from a Pichai post); not fetched from a primary page, so not used.

info.description: Google's Gemini assistant app on web, Android and iOS, with a free plan and Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscriptions that add higher usage limits, video generation and storage.

business_source.quote: Free $0; Google AI Plus $4.99; AI Pro $19.99; AI Ultra from $99.99; Gemini Enterprise Business $21 per seat per month
business_source.note: Quote is the fetcher's table of the page, not a single sentence.

genspark.include_reason: ARR, valuation, funding verified from two fetched press pages (company statements); plan prices verified on the vendor help center.

monthly_arr.attributed_to: Genspark announcement of 2026-06-17 (businesswire, 403 to the fetcher)
monthly_arr.quote: The company grew from $0 to $250M ARR within 12 months.
monthly_arr.note: The same page and the Reuters text on boursorama give '$150M ARR added in Q1 2026, on top of $100M ARR since the April 2025 launch'. 250M is the page's own cumulative sentence.

valuation.quote: closed a $100M Series B extension at a $2.6B post-money valuation.
valuation.note: Confirmed by the Reuters text on boursorama.com (2026-06-17): 'qui la valorise a 2,6 milliards de dollars'.

funding.unit: total Series B (lower bound of total raised)
funding.quote: The extension brings Genspark's total Series B funding to $485M.
funding.note: The same page also says '$645 million total funding'; other trackers say about $545M. The 485M is the only figure two fetched pages agree on, so total raised is at least this.

features: Super Agent chat and cloud task runs
Live tool calls and artifacts inside the conversation
Agent can work on the user's local files (desktop Super App)
Cloud task list synced between desktop app and web
info.features_note: Only 4 verified features, so the 'more than 5 features' completeness test does not fire. genspark.ai home page returned 403.

business_source.quote: Free $0 (100 credits / day); Plus $24.99 / month; Pro $249.99 / month; Team $40 / seat / month; Enterprise Custom
business_source.note: Quote is the fetcher's table of the page.

grok-app.include_reason: users (product, via press on the SpaceX filing) + funding (xAI statement, parent) + valuation (press, parent) verified. Pricing was third-party only and is null under owner ruling D84 #5; users and valuation are medium/low confidence.

users.attributed_to: SpaceX IPO filing (S-1); the filing itself was not fetched
users.quote: SpaceX revealed in its IPO filing that Grok had reached approximately 117 million monthly active users as of March 2026
users.note: Confirmed by socialmediatoday.com: 'The Grok chatbot from xAI currently sees about 117 million monthly active users'. Commentary says the count includes Grok inside X; the filing's definition was not read. as_of is the month end.

funding.quote: xAI completed its upsized Series E funding round, exceeding the $15 billion targeted round size, and raised $20 billion.
funding.note: One round, not lifetime funding. Date from convergedigest.com ('Announced Jan 6, 2026'); the x.ai page shows none in the fetch. xAI was later acquired by SpaceX (press, Feb 2026, not fetched).

valuation.quote: implies a very high valuation for the startup, reportedly in the range of about $230 billion.
valuation.note: The page also says 'xAI is yet to confirm this valuation.' The x.ai release states no valuation. Drop this field if the owner wants vendor-confirmed figures only.

info.description: xAI's Grok assistant app (separate row from the grok model family): chat with real-time web and X search, image and video generation, voice, DeepSearch, reasoning mode and companions, with a free plan and SuperGrok subscription.
features: Chat with real-time web and X search

features_source.note: x.ai/grok returned 403 and grok.com shows only a chat box. Features are from Wikipedia's article; first 100,000 characters read.

info.business_ruling: Owner ruling D84 #5: every pricing field is null because the only source is the 2026-07 third-party page below (it gave freemium, base_price 30, free_tier true). The loader writes no pricing for this row.

business_source.quote: Grok (Free) $0; SuperGrok $30.00 per month (page last edited July 9, 2026, attributes prices to grok.com/supergrok)
business_source.note: A search result (not fetched) says xAI changed its plans on 2026-10-12. base_price may be stale; the owner may prefer to leave pricing null for this row.

hermes-agent.include_reason: github.stars and pypi downloads (both product, public APIs read today) plus funding/valuation (parent, press) verified; vendor page states the pricing tiers.

stars.note: Public unauthenticated GitHub API, read 2026-11-10. The github.com page showed 262.4k.

downloads_last_month.note: pypistats.org public API. PyPI package hermes-agent 0.19.0 lists author Nous Research. The existing collector uses the same shape (data.metrics.pypi.downloads_last_month).

funding.unit: Nous Research total raised after the October 2026 round
funding.quote: The round brings total funding to about $158 million
funding.note: Single aggregator citing WSJ. The Block (2026-07-14) reports only 'at least $75 million ... unconfirmed'. Nous Research's own announcement was not found.

valuation.quote: has raised $90 million at a $1.5 billion valuation
valuation.note: Same page: 'The company did not disclose the valuation itself.' The Block page (https://www.theblock.co/post/408237) gives $1.5 billion for a round still 'in talks'.

info.description: Open-source, MIT-licensed agent with persistent memory, scheduled tasks and subagents, reachable from the CLI and chat apps such as Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp and Signal.

Persistent memory that learns projects and auto-generates skills
Isolated subagents with their own terminals and Python RPC scripts
Web search, browser automation, vision, image generation and text-to-speech
Sandboxed execution backends (local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal)
Full terminal UI with streaming tool output
Batch trajectory generation for training tool-calling models

business_source.quote: Hermes Agent is free and open source under the MIT license; hosted tiers Free $0, Plus $20, Super $100, Ultra $200 per month
business_source.note: Software is free; base_price is the cheapest paid hosted tier. Quote is the fetcher's summary of the page.

manus.include_reason: ARR (vendor, product) + valuation and funding (press, company) verified; the vendor docs confirm Free, Pro and Team plans. No user count.

monthly_arr.quote: Manus has crossed $100M in ARR, eight months after launch.
monthly_arr.note: Eleven months old at checked_at. Sacra (sacra.com/c/manus, third_party_estimate) estimates $450M annualised revenue in June 2026; not used because it is an estimate. The same post says total revenue run rate is over $125M.

valuation.quote: at a reported valuation of more than $2 billion.
valuation.note: Sacra also says backers pursued a buyback in June 2026 'at roughly the same $2 billion valuation Meta paid'. Ownership status after that was not verified; as_of is the month of the December 2025 deal.

funding.note: as_of is the month of the last equity round (April 2025 Series B). Before the Meta deal.

info.description: General-purpose AI agent that builds slides, websites, games, video and designs from one prompt, with a web app, desktop app, Slack integration, API and a Team plan.
features: Web app, desktop app and My Browser

microsoft-copilot.include_reason: Two Microsoft parent figures (Copilot-family MAU, AI-business run rate; D80.1) verified from fetched pages; prices verified on the vendor page. No consumer-app-only user figure exists.

users.unit: monthly active users, first-party family of Copilots (commercial and consumer)
users.attributed_to: Microsoft FY26 Q1 earnings call, Satya Nadella
users.quote: our first-party family of Copilots now has surpassed 150 million monthly active users

Counts GitHub, Microsoft 365 and consumer Copilots together; Microsoft declined to give a breakdown (TechCrunch, search result, not fetched). funding.quote: We are announcing a Series C funding round of 1.7B€ at a 11.7B€ post-money valuation.
